brief:
Implement slugify(text) in slug.py, standard library only.

- Lowercase the text.
- Replace every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits with a single hyphen.
- Remove leading and trailing hyphens.
- Truncate to at most 40 characters, then remove a trailing hyphen the cut leaves.
- Return "n-a" when the result is empty.
- Raise TypeError("text must be a str") when text is not a str.

fixtures.check.py:
from slug import slugify

assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
assert slugify("  --Already--Slugged--  ") == "already-slugged"
assert slugify("\u00dcn\u00efc\u00f6d\u00e9") == "n-c-d"
assert slugify("a" * 50) == "a" * 40
assert slugify("x" * 39 + " y") == "x" * 39
assert slugify("!!!") == "n-a"
try:
    slugify(5)
except TypeError as exc:
    assert str(exc) == "text must be a str"
else:
    raise AssertionError("slugify(5) did not raise TypeError")
print("all checks pass")
